Name: Enemies Health Bars for Vintage V1 and V2
Author: eliwiili
Description:
[b]NOTE:[/b] This is not a mod, only images. You'll need to download [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3627]Enemies Health Bars[/url] and replace the image with the one that matches your interface mod.


[b]﻿INFO
[/b]
This recolors the health bar from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3627]Enemies Health Bars[/url] to match the colors of Vintage Interface [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1244]V1[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4697]V2[/url].
Although there aren't any vines or flowers, it matches [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6166]Overgrown Flowery Interface[/url] as well.

Enemies Health Bars﻿ is an updated version of an older, outdated mod called Enemy Health Bars by Maurício Gomes.
You can find the original mod on [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/193]Nexus[/url] and on the author's [url=https://gitlab.com/speeder1/SMAPIHealthbarMod]github[/url].


[b]INSTALLATION[/b]

- Navigate to "assets" within the EnemyHealthBars folder.
- ﻿Drag and drop the version of SDV_lifebar.png that corresponds with your interface mod into the assets folder.
- Replace the existing file.

Keep a backup of the original SDV_lifebar.png if you'd like to revert back at any point.
